answer_1.quote: We consider lexical substitution, the task of generating a list of substitutes w that can replace a given target word w in a given context c
answer_1.outputs: substitutes for a target word in context

answer_2.quote: we compute precision (P k ) and recall (R k ) at k ... we report F k , the harmonic mean of P k and R k ... we evaluate against the list of substitutes which humans judged as conceivable (score > 0%)

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to crowdsource labels on substitutes
answer_4.guideline: We ask annotators whether they "would actually consider using this substitute as the author of the original sentence,"
